about: The kit's default pronunciations for the Kokoro voices, merged with course/pronunciations.json (the course wins). 'words' gives exact sounds as phonemes (Kokoro/misaki notation), sent as [word](/phonemes/) so every voice says them the same way: 'us' for the American voices (af_, am_), 'gb' for the British ones (bf_, bm_). Matching is whole-word and ignores case. 'spell' is a plain respelling, matched exactly. Any other word of two or more capitals is read letter by letter (DNA: dee en ay). See pronunciations.example.json for a course file.
